author: Unity
description:
What does it mean to set the benchmark for Unity tools?

In this video, we sit down with Bryan and Andreas of Sirenix. the team behind industry favorites like Odin Inspector and Serializer, and Odin Validator, to talk about their 8-year journey and the evolving landscape of the Asset Store. With over 100,000 users worldwide, the team discusses how third-party tools are becoming vital for navigating increasingly complex pipelines and keeping fast-paced development cycles on track. We also discuss Unity Core Standards, and the rules and "approval stamp" for assets, making it easier for studios to vet reliable tools.
